digest.component_or_area: review-bot event store and persistent clone management
propositions: Two uncommitted event JSON files exist in the persistent review-bot clone, predating the A6-0b deployment, while HEAD equals refs/remotes/origin/tickets with no tracked diff or rebase state.

The first file is a superseded unsigned derived-cache TICKET_DIGEST sidecar for a closed ticket with seven newer committed digests; the second is an expired and superseded CLAIM_ENRICH queue artifact with a later completed claim in authoritative history.
Both artifacts are disposable residue rather than unique canonical events requiring recovery through normal store write paths.

Clean-clone verification confirmed HEAD equals refs/remotes/origin/tickets, git status contained exactly the two authorized files with matching SHA-256 hashes, and all merge/rebase/stash state was absent before safe deletion.

After authorized disposal of both exact files, the persistent clone showed empty git status and remained synchronized with origin/tickets, proving no unique canonical event was lost prior to the A6-1 publication window.
